cam.palette.title: Machining Strategy
cam.palette.subtitle: Fusion-style strategy palette
cam.palette.wireHint: Click a strategy to load its parameters into the generator below.
cam.strategy.contourDesc: Follows the external or internal profile of the part while keeping vertical walls.
cam.strategy.pocketDesc: Clears material inside a closed profile to produce a flat-bottom cavity.
cam.strategy.faceDesc: Mills a flat reference surface — establishes a Z zero on the stock top.
cam.strategy.slotDesc: Roughs a closed slot with a multi-pass ramp or plunge routine.
cam.strategy.engraveDesc: Traces shallow lines following a path (logos, part numbers).
cam.strategy.threadMillingDesc: Helical milling of internal / external threads with a single-point cutter.
cam.strategy.zLevelRoughDesc: Clears stock in successive Z levels around the part, with finishing pass.
cam.strategy.parallelDesc: Raster on the finished surface at the configured angle (scallop height).
cam.strategy.waterlineDesc: Constant-Z contours — perfect for steep walls and draft areas.
cam.strategy.pencilDesc: Corner cleanup with a small cutter — touch-up around fillets.
cam.strategy.scallopDesc: Cusp-height aware finishing that adapts the stepover to the geometry.
cam.strategy.flowlineDesc: Follows the surface curvature — ideal for organic / style surfaces.
cam.strategy.adaptiveDesc: Engagement-bounded radial cutting — keeps tool load constant (Hypermill-style).
cam.strategy.restDesc: Clears only what a previous, larger tool left behind.
cam.strategy.drillDesc: Standard drilling cycle with retract and optional dwell.
cam.strategy.deepDrillDesc: Peck / chip-break cycle for deep holes with chip evacuation.
cam.strategy.peckDrillDesc: Peck-drilling at a fixed depth of cut between retracts.
cam.strategy.chipBreakDesc: High-frequency retracts to break the chip without full chip evacuation.
cam.strategy.reamingDesc: Finishes a pre-drilled hole to a precise diameter with a reamer.
cam.strategy.boringDesc: Precision internal boring — widens and finishes a hole.
cam.strategy.backBoreDesc: Inverse boring — counterbore from the back of a through hole.
cam.strategy.tappingDesc: Metric / imperial tapping with rigid or floating holder support.
cam.strategy.centerDesc: Spot drill — establishes a chamfered start hole for the main drill.
cam.strategy.index32Desc: Oriented 5-axis machining — head tilts, table rotates between cuts, motion is 3-axis per index.
cam.strategy.axis4Desc: Continuous 4-axis wrapping — rotary axis as Y.
cam.strategy.axis5SimDesc: True simultaneous 5-axis tool motion — full tool-axis control.
cam.strategy.probeDesc: Touch probe finds the work zero on the top surface, edge, corner, bore or boss.
cam.strategy.toolLengthDesc: Tool setter / touch probe length calibration cycle.
cam.strategy.facingDesc: Cross-pass over the face from OD to centre on a lathe (G18).
cam.strategy.turningODDesc: External cylindrical turning with radial passes (G18, X as diameter).
cam.strategy.turningIDDesc: Internal boring / turning — widens pre-bored holes.
cam.strategy.threadingODDesc: OD/ID threading cycle with lead-in and pitch-correct passes (G76-compatible).
cam.strategy.groovingDesc: Width-tool groove following an arbitrary profile.
cam.strategy.partingDesc: Radial cut-off to a diameter along Z.
cam.strategy.knurlingDesc: Diamond or straight knurl pattern on the OD (rolling pass).
cam.strategy.printStandardDesc: Standard slicer settings — wall, infill, top / bottom, supports.
cam.strategy.printVaseDesc: Spiral continuous extrusion with no seams for hollow objects.
cam.strategy.printRaftDesc: Raft under the part for bed adhesion.
cam.strategy.printBrimDesc: Brim of extra perimeters around the part for bed adhesion.
cam.features.title: Production CAM Features
cam.features.subtitle: Everything a Fusion 360 / Hypermill workstation exposes, in one pane.
cam.features.cad.title: Solid Surfacing (CAD)
cam.features.cad.items: Parametric Extrude / Revolve • Mesh Booleans (Union / Subtract / Intersect) • Chamfer (Edge) • Shell (hollow body) • Sweep (profile along path) • Loft (between sections) • 2D Sketch Constraints (22 kinds) • DXF R12/R2000 round-trip
cam.features.mill.title: Milling Strategies
cam.features.mill.items: 2.5D: Profile • Pocket • Drill (peck / chip-break / dwell) • Face • Engrave • Slot • Thread mill
cam.features.mill.items2: 3D: Roughing (Z-level) • Parallel finish • Waterline • Scallop • Flowline • Adaptive clear • Rest machining • Pencil cleanup
cam.features.mill.items3: Multi-axis: Index 3+2 on AC/BC trunnion • 4-axis continuous (rotary) • 5-axis swarf • 5-axis simultaneous
cam.features.lathe.title: Lathe Strategies
cam.features.lathe.items: Facing • Turning OD • Turning ID (boring) • Parting • Grooving (with profile) • Threading (OD / ID) • Knurling
cam.features.drill.title: Drilling Cycles
cam.features.drill.items: Simple Drilling • Deep Drilling (G83) • Chip Breaking (G73) • Tapping (G84, rigid) • Boring (G76) • Back Boring (G87) • Reaming • Center Drilling • Thread Milling • Countersink
cam.features.probe.title: Probing & Setup
cam.features.probe.items: Z zero on surface • X/Y edge zero • Corner zero • Bore / boss centre • Tool length (tool setter) • Spindle probe CSS-class dialect (linuxcnc / Fanuc)
cam.features.verify.title: Verification & Simulation
cam.features.verify.items: Height-field stock removal • Gouge against finished part • Flutes / shank / holder modelling • Box / sphere / cylinder fixtures • Remaining stock map • G-code parser + replay • Stale-result indicator
cam.features.workflow.title: Workflow
cam.features.workflow.items: Multi-toolpath manager • Generate-all • Post-processors (Fanuc / GRBL / Heidenhain / generic) • DXF / G-code import-export • Project library • Production cost calculator • AI copilot (BYO-key) • VCS history (git-style) • Actions-style workflows
